preprod-play-to-record.text: The October target is a Cardano preprod handoff. Keripy creates and exports the signed identity event. Cardano KERI registers that identity, while a released Singular interface must supply the registry custody, booking and retirement transactions. The target is Singular version one point zero point zero; the Cardano KERI follower and a persistent Singular registry read path must establish fresh indexed state.

recording-gate.text: A cast will be attached after the released keripy, Cardano KERI and Singular commands complete on preprod and their transaction IDs and fresh readbacks are verified. The planned sequence is not a completed demo.
